lines.text: Emma started at dawn on a grassy trail.
Every blade was covered in cold dew, and within a mile her cotton leggings were soaked and clinging to her legs.
Wet cotton stays wet and pulls heat from your body.
Here's the fix. Wear quick-dry nylon pants with a water-repellent finish.
They shed dew and light drizzle and dry fast once the sun is out.
Pack a rain shell for real rain.
Save this before your next morning hike.
